title: When Where What Tailgate
description: Austin's biggest tailgate experience featuring free drinks, free food, games, music, and giant TVs showing college football games.

title: Understated Leather & Allen's Boots Warehouse Sale
description: Understated Leather and Allen's Boots are hosting a massive warehouse sale featuring up to 90% off leather, denim, western wear, cowboy boots, and complimentary Topo Chico Sabores.

title: Free Tree Adoptions at Tech Ridge H-E-B
location: Tech Ridge H-E-B, 500 Canyon Ridge, Austin, TX
description: TreeFolks, the City of Austin, and Austin Energy are giving away free trees on a first-come, first-served basis. Open to residents showing an Austin Energy bill or located in the city's Full Purpose Jurisdiction (up to 2 trees per household).

title: Texas Monthly BBQ Fest
description: Texas Monthly BBQ Fest features a free BBQ World's Fair on Saturday with live music, vendor market, and demos, followed by the Top 50 Picnic on Sunday featuring 36 top Texas BBQ joints.

title: Tumble22 Arboretum Grand Opening
location: Tumble22, 9761 Great Hills Trail, Austin, TX 78759
description: Tumble22 is opening at The Arboretum, and the first 75 people in line get a free OG sandwich every month for a year.

title: Travis Heights Art Trail
description: Stroll through Travis Heights and shop local artists displaying work at various home studios during this free annual art walk.

title: Kinda Good Tattoo Convention
description: Kinda Good Tattoo Convention at Kinda Tropical featuring flash tattoo artists, vendors, food, and live entertainment.

title: Mini Cows & Pilates
description: Mini Cows & Pilates event featuring cold plunge, sauna, open-play padel, Hyrox fitness challenges, a live DJ, and photo ops.

title: Witchy Apothecary Pop-Up at Lucille Patio Lounge
description: Lucille Patio Lounge has transformed into a witchy apothecary featuring glowing decor, eerie curiosities, smoking cocktails, and photo ops with no cover charge through November 9.

title: Kitty Cohen's
description: Smokin' Dough Pizza at Kitty Cohen's offers two margaritas and a pizza for $26 every Monday through November.

title: CJ Hendry Flower Shop Pop-Up
description: Australian artist CJ Hendry brings her flower shop pop-up to East Austin, featuring a whimsical wonderland of oversized collectible plush flowers.

title: Seismic Dance Event 9.0
description: Seismic Dance Event 9.0 returns to The Concourse Project from November 13-15 featuring a full lineup of electronic music artists.

title: Creek Show
description: Creek Show features ten light-based installations created by local artists illuminating Waller Creek from 4th St to Lady Bird Lake, alongside food, drinks, and special activities at Creek Monster Cove.

title: Austin Mac & Cheese Festival
description: The Austin Mac & Cheese Festival brings cheesy creations from some of Austin's best chefs to Star Hill Ranch, where attendees can taste delicious bites and help crown the champion.

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...
description: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015 This happens to be our 9,000th post (hell ya) From our founder @champagnecates: Our first post ever was SLAB BBQ’s 1 year anniversary with $1 drinks and $1 sandwiches. After 11 years I can honestly say that WWW has the same heart, same ethos, same community-driven mentality from day one. I set out to change the way event-goer and event were connected. I wanted to combine my writing background and my partying background to deliver plans and news in a minimal and personable new way. I feel like we really did all that. title: Texas Wienerfest
description: Texas Wienerfest is the world's largest Dachshund meetup featuring amateur dog races, live music, low rider limbo, wiener wellness spa, pup cup eating contest, and more.
